notes: Both full primary sources verified by title and DOI. Original source is an accepted manuscript with manuscript pagination. Replication supplied locator p.7 refers to Experiment 2, while study_r explicitly identifies Experiment 1; the matching Experiment 1 test is on p.4 and was extracted independently. target_match=true reflects the named Experiment 1 and matching outcome/sample/test, with the page discrepancy retained here. Both effects are the printed partial eta-squared for the main effect of thinking mode on discrimination d-prime; no metric conversions were performed. Neither paper documents participant exclusions for the assigned experiment; analytic sample counts are supported by the participant descriptions and ANOVA degrees of freedom.
